_readme: TMP_009 iteration 8 — Phase A.v6 hybrid. Iter 6 was peak (0/9/0). Iter 7 over-tightened with anti-X clauses → 0/0/9 regression via negation paradox (forbidden concepts amplified). This iteration takes iter 6's working prompt verbatim + ONE thing from iter 7: the explicit per-biome color hints (which lifted C4 6→9/9 with no downside). Goal: lift C4 to 9/9 while preserving iter 6's 0/9/0 (zero outright fails). Same base, same zero LoRA, same fixture.
